items.title: High growth and demographic efficiency turned into fiscal penalty for Telangana?
points: It appears so going by the report “Public finances of Telangana: Trends, challenges and policy priorities” released by the Centre for Economic and Social Studies (CESS) recently.
The study made a comparison between the allocations made in the 14th and 15th Finance Commissions and said the State’s share has declined primarily due to income distance and forest cover.

The report said Telangana’s forest cover declined by 21% as also the share of income distance (the difference between State’s per capita GSDP and a benchmark level for horizontal devolution of central taxes) by 55% from the 14th to 15th Finance Commission…
“On per capita GSDP distance, the State’s economic growth has become a penalty for higher shares,” the report said.
The new formula of the 16th Finance Commission using square root of the State’s GSDP to calculate contribution to the GDP for horizontal tax devolution has again penalised economic growth.

items.title: Stamford firms up 10 MR tankers in China

items.title: Keralam mulling community-based system for early identification of at-risk children, providing support
points: FOLKS – Friends of Little Kids is envisaged as a structured child protection early warning and intervention initiative that focusses on children who may be facing abuse, neglect, abandonment, or other forms of harm but go unnoticed until very late, besides…
FOLKS will tap into the network of Social Work students and faculty members and professionally qualified social work practitioners who work in the child protection and welfare sectors.

These FOLKS members will observe and report physical or emotional abuse, repeated injuries, severe neglect, malnutrition or starvation, child labour, child marriage risks, unsafe living conditions, dropping out of schools, and similar other situations.
The reporting will be done through Childline 1098, district child protection units (DCPUs), designated district-level WhatsApp groups, and child protection nodal officers.
The WhatsApp groups will include DCPU officials, Childline representatives, police nodal officers, social work college coordinators, and FOLKS representatives.
As serious incidents usually occur in households already experiencing social distress, DCPUs may maintain a confidential vulnerable family support register.

The verdict brings a crucial phase of one of Kerala's most politically sensitive murder cases to a close, following a prolonged legal battle, a change of investigating agency and allegations of a political conspiracy involving senior CPI(M) leaders.

items.title: Toyota Sales Breakup Oct 2026 – Hyryder, Hycross, Crysta, Fortuner, Glanza

items.title: Toyota Boss: High Global NCAP Rating NOT Equal To High Safety
points: A senior Toyota executive has questioned the way Global NCAP assesses car safety, arguing that a crash-test star rating does not tell the entire story.
Andrew Kirby, president and CEO of Toyota South Africa Motors, made the remarks during an interview at SA Auto Week in Durban.
His argument is that an entry-level car can receive a poor rating even though more expensive versions of the same model offer additional safety equipment.
The comments have come after disappointing crash-test results for the locally built Corolla Cross and the Toyota Starlet sold in South Africa.
In January 2026, Global NCAP gave the South African-built Toyota Corolla Cross two stars for adult-occupant protection and three for child protection.
Under Global NCAP's tougher 2025 assessment rules, cars without standard side-head protection cannot secure more than two stars for adult protection.
The Corolla Cross achieved 29.27 points out of 34 in the adult assessment, but it still faced that ceiling.

items.title: Weatherford bags new deepwater drilling deal in Brazil

It also includes the sale of an MPD system, scheduled for delivery within 12 months, and a two-year aftermarket services contract.
Weatherford will support the programme through its Brazilian operations and Managed Pressure Wells Centre of Excellence in Houston.
The 2012-delivered Amaralina Star can operate in water depths of up to 10,000 feet and drill wells to depths of 40,000 feet.
Constellation secured a three-year, approximately $528m contract with Petrobras for the drillship in December 2024, covering operations beginning in the first quarter of 2026.
That agreement includes work in frontier exploration areas such as Brazil’s Equatorial Margin and Pelotas Basin, with an option for up to 315 additional days.

The announcement comes a year after a Class 10 student of St Columba's School died by suicide amid allegations of harassment by teachers.
Education Minister Ashish Sood, speaking at the launch, recalled the November 18, 2025 death and questioned whether fixing accountability after such tragedies was enough.

items.title: Centre proposes separate licensing framework for wholesale trade of bulk drugs
points: New Delhi, The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has proposed a separate licensing framework for the wholesale trade of bulk drugs, including active and inactive bulk substances, to strengthen regulatory oversight and accountability in the…

The proposed amendments to the Drugs Rules, 1945, seek to introduce separate application and licence forms for the wholesale of bulk drugs, distinct from the existing licensing provisions for formulations.
At present, a common licence covers the wholesale of both formulations and bulk drugs.

The proposed amendment seeks to establish a dedicated licensing framework for bulk drugs, enabling more focused regulatory oversight of their wholesale trade and greater accountability in the pharmaceutical supply chain, the ministry said in a statement.
The proposal was agreed upon by the Drugs Consultative Committee at its 67th meeting on November 17, 2025, and by the Drugs Technical Advisory Board at its 93rd meeting on February 16, 2026.

items.title: Real-Life Mirzapur? Story Of UP's Tiwari Haata That Akhilesh Yadav Visited
points: If the web series Mirzapur offered viewers a glimpse into the murky world of Purvanchal's mafia-politics nexus, the story of Tiwari Haata in Gorakhpur had been unfolding in real life long before the cameras arrived.
And on November 18, as Akhilesh Yadav's PDA Rath rolled through the streets of Gorakhpur, the Samajwadi Party chief made a pit stop that carried considerable political significance.

He visited Tiwari Haata, the ancestral home of the late Hari Shankar Tiwari - widely regarded as Purvanchal's original Bahubali (strongman) and one of the most influential Brahmin leaders in eastern Uttar Pradesh.
Read | Samajwadi Seat Talks: The UP-Size Gap Between Congress' Rhetoric and Reality Hari Shankar Tiwari won the Chillupar Assembly constituency in Gorakhpur six times between 1985 and 2007.

items.title: India-US ties at historic high, working towards fair, reciprocal trade relationship: US envoy
points: New Delhi, India-US relations stand at a historic high point, with both governments working closely to build a fair, reciprocal and mutually beneficial trade relationship, a senior American diplomat said on Thursday.
Addressing the 23rd Indo-US Economic Summit here, US Deputy Chief of Mission Jason Meeks called for reducing trade barriers, ensuring fair market access and strengthening supply chain resilience.
"Our two governments are working very closely together to build a trade relationship that is fair, reciprocal and mutually beneficial," Meeks said.
"When trade is fair and reciprocal, workers and companies on both sides win," he said.

Referring to the Pax Silica initiative, Meeks said the US, India and other countries recently signed the San Francisco Declaration to strengthen the partnership, underlining the importance of resilient supply chains.

Pax Silica is a US-led international coalition launched in December 2025 to build secure, resilient supply chains for artificial intelligence , semiconductors, and critical minerals among trusted allies.

items.title: GTA 6 Download Size on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S: How Much Space Do You Need?
points: Here is how much space you should set aside for GTA 6 and what you can do if your console is running low.
Grand Theft Auto 6 has been launched on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X After years of anticipation, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here.
The Take-Two-owned company has confirmed that GTA 6 requires a massive amount of storage space on both the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
According to Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto 6 requires up to 212GB of available storage, depending on the console.
The game is available on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and the developer advises players to ensure they have enough space before installing it.
Some reported download sizes may be slightly smaller than 212GB.

Players without 212GB of free space will need to remove some installed games or use compatible storage expansion options.

items.title: Bombay HC halts demolition of ‘Musafir Khana’, building where Dawood Ibrahim once lived with family
points: The Bombay high court on Thursday halted the demolition of ‘Musafir Khana’, the family house of fugitive gangster Dawood Ibrahim Kaskar in Mumbai’s Pakmodia Street locality.

The order came on a petition challenging the action initiated by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Thursday to demolish the Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana building, where Dawood Ibrahim once lived with his family.
Officials said the demolition is part of the Bhendi Bazaar cluster redevelopment project being undertaken by the Saifee Burhani Upliftment Trust (SBUT).
The trust had requested the BMC to demolish the structure, citing a 2020 Bombay high court order, as the building falls along the proposed internal road alignment of the redevelopment project.

Located on Pakmodia Street in the Bhendi Bazaar area, the building was being demolished because of its dilapidated condition and redevelopment requirements, and not because of its association with Dawood.
Dating back to the early 1900s, the building predates Dawood's association with it.

items.title: ‘Misuse discussion for propaganda’: India slams Pakistan over Indus Waters Treaty
points: India slammed Pakistan at a United Nations Security Council Arria-formula meeting, directly accusing its military of looting the country's natural resources for personal gain and triggering domestic political turmoil to keep control over them.

Speaking at the session convened by Liberia on natural resources and conflict, India's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Parvathaneni Harish, hit back after the Pakistani delegation brought up the Indus Waters Treaty.
He clarified that New Delhi had no plans to discuss bilateral disputes during the meeting, but refused to let Islamabad's remarks go unanswered.

"Mr Chair, it was not our intention to bring other issues into this forum, but my delegation is compelled to respond to the comment made by the delegation of Pakistan that has chosen to misuse today's discussion to peddle its propaganda.

The Indian envoy indirectly pointed to Pakistan army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir gifting a box of minerals to US President Donald Trump and linked Pakistan military's direct involvement in resource extraction to recent political crackdowns in the country.

The suspect was arrested after an exchange of fire with police personnel.
Police said the minor girl is a student and lives in the Badalpur village.
On Wednesday night, the suspect took the minor to the agricultural field on the pretext of some work and raped her.
“When the minor girl tried to protest, the suspect assaulted her,” said a police officer.
“Her condition is stable,” said Noida police in a statement.
Police said a rape and assault case under relevant sections of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was registered at Badalpur police station.

items.title: Guinea storms into iron ore export top three
points: Guinea has overtaken South Africa to become the world’s third-largest seaborne iron ore exporter, with the rapid ramp-up of the giant Simandou project providing a fresh boost to long-haul capesize demand.
New figures from shipping association BIMCO show Guinean iron ore shipments topped 5m tonnes for the first time in October, giving the West African country a 3% share of global seaborne volumes.

BIMCO shipping analysis manager Filipe Gouveia calculates that Guinean ore travels, on average, 88% farther than a typical seaborne iron ore shipment, with exports heading almost exclusively to China.
That helped Guinea account for 6% of global iron ore tonne-mile demand in October, double its share by cargo volume.
Growing shipments from the country also helped lift worldwide iron ore tonne-miles by 2% during the first ten months of 2026, despite little change in overall volumes.
If Simandou reaches its planned annual output of 120m tonnes without displacing existing exports, global iron ore tonne-mile demand could rise by 13% compared with 2025 levels.

points: The Delhi high court on Thursday issued notice in jailed Lok Sabha member Abdul Rashid Sheikh’s petition against a trial court’s order framing charges against him and six others in a money laundering case linked to alleged funding from Pakistan through…
A bench of Justice Sachin Datta sought the Enforcement Directorate (ED)’s response in Sheikh’s petition against the trial court’s September 9 order and fixed the matter for hearing next week.

In his petition, Sheikh, through his lawyer Vikhyat Oberoi, called the order erroneous.

items.title: Year after Hidma’s killing, Andhra cops unearth explosives hidden in Polavaram forests
points: A year after the killing of Communist Party of India (Maoist) commander Madvi Hidma in an encounter with Andhra Pradesh police, security forces on Wednesday unearthed a huge cache of explosives allegedly concealed by him in Polavaram forests along the…
Hidma was killed in an encounter with security forces of the Andhra Pradesh police at Maredumilli forests of Alluri Sitarama Raju district on November 18 last year.

According to Polavaram district superintendent of police K Chakravarthi, the police had seized 670 live Barrel Grenade Launcher (BGL) shells and several other explosive materials during the operation.

The operation was conducted by a special team constituted with the assistance of personnel from the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), following specific intelligence inputs about the presence of a concealed Maoist explosives dump in the border region.

“The recovery was the outcome of sustained surveillance, intelligence gathering and follow-up operations undertaken by Andhra Pradesh police as part of their continuing efforts to combat Left Wing Extremism (LWE),” Chakravarthi said.

points: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday asked India Inc to suggest, without any hesitation or reluctance, more reforms that are necessary for further growth of the country.

Addressing industry body FICCI' Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention, the prime minister also asked corporates to focus on making India self-reliant, and urged them to invest heavily in agriculture and allied sectors.
PM Modi highlighted achievements of his government in the last 12-13 years, and lauded efforts made by all sections of the society.
He said the pace of progress in India is very fast, and at the same time, the speed at which people are moving out of poverty is also very fast.
Citing the latest World Bank report, PM Modi said in just 12-13 years, 50 crore people have overcome poverty.
PM Modi said the basic corporate tax rate has been reduced from 30 per cent in 2014 to 22 per cent, and individual income of up to Rs 12 lakh a year is also tax-free.

items.title: Mercedes Wants To Cut New Car Development Time By 30%: How Software Will Help
points: A new Mercedes-Benz model can take years to move from the drawing board to a showroom.
The German luxury carmaker now wants to shorten that process significantly, with a development-time reduction of around 30% under consideration as it expands its software-defined vehicle strategy.
The aim is to bring new products and features to customers more quickly, without having to redesign every part of a car at the same time.
Steffen Tacke, Director of Research and Development at Mercedes-Benz AG, explained the thinking to Autocar Professional at Vector Informatik's NEXT HORIZONS 2026 event in Germany.
Conventional vehicle development, he said, often takes 44 to 60 months.
Some newer manufacturers have brought their cycles down to 36 months or even 18 months.
Introduced with the new CLA in 2025, it is designed to connect infotainment, automated driving, body and comfort functions, and driving and charging systems.
If the strategy succeeds, buyers could see more frequent improvements in connected features and shorter gaps between new products.

items.title: Amit Shah inaugurates key anti-terror conference; deliberations to focus on cross-border terrorism
points: Held annually, the conference has steadily grown into a significant gathering of operational forces, agencies working in the field of counter-terrorism, and experts from the technical, legal and forensic domains.
It offers the agencies/forces an opportunity to collectively examine matters that have bearing on national security and the threats arising from terrorism.
In keeping with the 'whole of government approach', the conference places particular emphasis on fostering synergy among all stakeholders.
The conference also aims at contributing substantive inputs towards the formulation of future policy, a statement issued by the Home Ministry has said.
The conference is being organised by the National Investigation Agency as a part of a continued effort to bolster the nation's collective response to terrorism.
This year's conference deliberates on the theme "cross-border terrorism", it said.

Over the two days, the deliberations will enable law enforcement agencies to share their experiences, highlight good practices in handling counter-terrorism matters, and draw upon lessons learnt from terror investigations.

Tourism stakeholders gathered at Palolem on Tuesday to denounce the forest department’s moves to expand the number of notified turtle nesting sites in Canacona.

points: India flagged Pakistan's military establishment of exploiting the country's natural resources for personal gain and fomenting conflict with neighbours at a UNSC meeting.

India's UN envoy Parvathaneni Harish also hit back at Islamabad for raising the Indus Waters Treaty, citing army chief Asim Munir's display of minerals to foreign leaders and calling on Pakistan's military to prioritise public welfare over self-aggrandisement.

Malaysia to not remain visa free for Indian visitors from Jan 1, 2027
points: Malaysia will end the visa exemption policy for Indian tourists beginning on January 1, 2027.
This decision comes after an increase in Indians misusing the visa-free entry for employment purposes.
The High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur has issued warnings regarding these violations of immigration rules.
Indian nationals must obtain a valid visa prior to travelling to Malaysia from this date onward.
